subject: ddl/ingest: set `minCommitTS` when detect remote duplicate keys (#55588)
summary: Passes DDL job `RealStartTS` through ingest backend context and uses it as `MinCommitTS` when calling TiKV `DuplicateDetect` for remote unique-index conflict checking; other dupe-detection paths keep prior behavior since `MinCommitTS` defaults to 0 unless explicitly set. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, concurrency, or DDL state/metadata handling for this change.
